brand-depth.use: Bold backgrounds: thumbnails, title slides, banners. White text.

midnight.use: Dark premium surfaces; Bold social and video. White text. A calm pattern may sit on it.

ai.use: AI content only. White text. No pattern.

glow.use: Behind a product shot, events, hero moments. White text. No pattern.

soft-blue.use: Calm web sections, text-heavy slides, email headers. Grey160 text.

soft-violet.use: Calm sections for AI content only. Grey160 text.

soft-yellow.use: Warm highlight sections, offers and events. Grey160 text.

print.notes: Fonts embedded. Total ink below 300%. Ask for one printed proof before a full run.

descriptions.role/status/error: Errors only, never CTAs. Uses red/100.
descriptions.role/accent/highlight: Highlight boxes and fills; dark text on top. Uses yellow/100.
